Implement `RingBuffer` so the following tests pass:

```python
def test_ring_buffer():
    rb = RingBuffer(capacity=3)
    assert rb.is_empty()
    assert not rb.is_full()

    rb.push(1); rb.push(2); rb.push(3)
    assert rb.is_full()
    assert rb.peek() == 1

    # Overwrite oldest on overflow
    rb.push(4)
    assert rb.pop() == 2
    assert rb.pop() == 3
    assert rb.pop() == 4
    assert rb.is_empty()

    # Iterate without consuming
    rb.push(10); rb.push(20)
    assert list(rb) == [10, 20]
    assert not rb.is_empty()
```
